description.html: The 34x20x28 cm terrarium has 680 cm² of floor and about 19 liters. The 20 cm width keeps it shallow enough for a narrow shelf, and 28 cm of height is relatively a lot for this length, which benefits climbing species. Inside is a 3D styrofoam background.

Young crested and gargoyle geckos use exactly that height: a branch leaning from the front bottom corner toward the top of the background gives them a route through the whole terrarium. A juvenile leopard gecko stays on the floor, where two small hides fit. A young corn snake uses both. Day geckos need UVB light above the mesh.

Anyone who wants the same length with a wider floor can take the 35x25x30 or 35x30x25. You choose the film pattern for the outer sides from 34 samples. Different dimensions, or a row of identical terrariums for a shelf, are built in 7 to 14 days. We ship finished terrariums by courier to an address anywhere in Serbia.
